claims.text: Grand Hyatt Shenzhen is in the heart of the city, within its established commercial and financial district.

findings.quote: Grand Hyatt Shenzhen is ideally located in the heart of the city, within the city’s established commercial and financial district.

claims.text: The hotel is housed in a distinctive 38-storey crested building.

findings.quote: Grand Hyatt Shenzhen is housed in a distinctive 38-storey crested building.

claims.text: The MixC Shopping Mall is adjacent to the hotel.

findings.quote: including the MixC Shopping Mall that’s adjacent to the hotel
findings.note: States the mall is adjacent to the hotel.

claims.text: Standard rooms have a glass-enclosed marble bath with a rain shower and a separate tub.

findings.quote: Spacious, 46-sq.-metre room features one king bed with deluxe bedding, floor-to-ceiling window, glass-enclosed marble bath with rain shower and separate tub
findings.note: The base room types are described with a glass-enclosed marble bath, rain shower and separate tub.

claims.text: The two-bedroom apartment has a living room, dining area, study and fully equipped kitchen.

findings.quote: Additional living spaces include a living room, dining area, study, and fully equipped kitchen.

claims.text: The Chairman Suite has a dining table for 10, a full kitchen and a private massage area.

findings.quote: plus living room, dining table for 10, full kitchen and private massage area

claims.text: The Grand Club offers guests in Club rooms and suites breakfast, afternoon tea, evening cocktails and a selection of wines.

findings.quote: The Grand Club is an exclusive retreat for guests staying in Club rooms and suites at Grand Hyatt Shenzhen.
findings.note: Establishes that the club serves Club room and suite guests.

findings.quote: Exclusive privileges include gourmet breakfast, afternoon tea, evening cocktails and a selection of sparkling, red and white wines.
findings.note: Lists breakfast, afternoon tea, evening cocktails and wines.

claims.text: The heated pool is on the 3rd-floor terrace and has a sun deck.

findings.quote: The heated pool at Grand Hyatt Shenzhen is located on our 3rd-floor terrace and features a sun deck

claims.text: Shui Xiang Spa offers massages, facials and body treatments.

findings.quote: a refreshing array of services, including massages, facials and body treatments
findings.note: From the Shui Xiang Spa description.

claims.text: The 24-hour fitness centre includes a foot reflexology and hydrotherapy area, a yoga studio and a steam room.

findings.quote: Health-conscious guests can enjoy our 24-hour fitness centre, which includes a foot reflexology and hydrotherapy area, cardio machines with LCD screens, a yoga studio, relaxation lounge and steam room.

claims.text: China Lodge is a Cantonese restaurant on the 35th to 37th floors with panoramic views of Shenzhen.

findings.quote: China Lodge, a high-end Cantonese cuisine restaurant, is located on the 35th to 37th floors of Grand Hyatt Hotel in Shenzhen. Here, guests can enjoy an excellent panoramic view of the beautiful scenery of Shenzhen.
findings.note: Covers the cuisine, the floors and the panoramic views.

claims.text: The Lounge on the 33rd floor looks out over the Shenzhen cityscape and the green mountains of northern Hong Kong.

findings.quote: Located on the 33rd floor of Grand Hyatt Shenzhen, The Lounge provides a stunning vantage point, showcasing the vibrant cityscape of Shenzhen on the left and the lush green mountain scenery of the northern Hong Kong region
findings.note: Covers the floor and both views.

claims.text: The hotel sits directly above a major transportation hub served by five intersecting metro lines.

findings.quote: Situated directly above a major transportation hub served by five intersecting metro lines

claims.text: The hotel is just minutes from the Luohu, Futian and Liantang border crossings, giving easy access between Shenzhen and Hong Kong.

findings.quote: Just minutes from the Luohu, Futian and Liantang border crossings, the property offers seamless access between Shenzhen and Hong Kong.

claims.text: All rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows with Shenzhen city views and Hong Kong mountain views.

findings.quote: This luxurious hotel in Shenzhen features 471 contemporary rooms and suites, all with floor-to-ceiling windows, offering magnificent Shenzhen city view and Hong Kong mountain view.
findings.note: States all rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows with both views.

claims.text: The Show Kitchen on the 32nd floor has floor-to-ceiling windows with views of both Shenzhen and Hong Kong.

findings.quote: Located on the 32nd floor of Grand Hyatt Shenzhen, The Show Kitchen has long been cherished by food enthusiasts. Its bright panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows offer breathtaking views of both Shenzhen and Hong Kong
findings.note: Covers the floor, the windows and both views.

claims.text: The hotel recommends that international guests use local mapping apps such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map, as international mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.

findings.quote: we recommend using local mapping applications such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map. International mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.

claims.text: Guests must wear a swimming cap in the pool, per Shenzhen Health Bureau regulations.

findings.quote: All guests must wear a swimming cap while in the pool, per Shenzhen Health Bureau regulations.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes that this large-scale hotel may feel less intimate for some guests.
